'''Lorahns''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]].

==History==
It was ruled by the powerful [[Order of the Ffib]] theocracy. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] once earned a 500,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] reward for capturing [[Nivek'Yppiks]], a [[Order of the Ffib|Ffib]] heretic wanted by Lorahns's leaders.
